title: Production database schema changes
rule: Schema changes to tier-1 databases need a tested rollback script and a DBA reviewer. Destructive changes (drop column, drop table) need a verified backup taken within 24 hours.

title: Change freeze windows
rule: No production deploys to tier-1 services during a declared freeze window unless the change is tagged emergency and approved by the service owner's director.

title: Canary and staged rollout
rule: Tier-1 service deploys go to a canary slice of at most 5 percent of traffic for at least 30 minutes before full rollout.

title: Configuration and feature flags
rule: Config-only changes behind a feature flag are low risk when the flag defaults to off and has a named owner.

title: Peer review
rule: Every production change needs one reviewer outside the author's team for tier-1 services, and any one reviewer for tier-2 and tier-3.
